title: UserAccount
description: A Workday user account representing a person or system that can authenticate to the Workday platform. Contains account credentials, status, and associated security configuration.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user account

descriptor.description: Display name of the user account

accountStatus.description: Current status of the user account

accountType.description: Type of account indicating whether it is a regular user account or an integration system user account

lastSignonDateTime.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful signon

accountExpirationDate.description: Date when the account is set to expire if an expiration is configured

passwordExpirationDate.description: Date when the current password will expire

mfaEnabled.description: Whether multi-factor authentication is enabled for this account
